title: Augustine on Tobit 12:19
body: “So these words spoken in the Book of Tobit, "You saw me eat, but you saw it but in vision;" that is, you thought I took food as you do for the sake of refreshing my body.”
author: Augustine, The City of God
bodyEs: “Así estas palabras dichas en el libro de Tobías: «Me viste comer, pero lo viste solo en visión»; esto es, pensaste que yo tomaba alimento como tú, por causa de refrescar mi cuerpo.”
